newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spicer-Mitchell slides after profit-warning.
newsitem.headline: Spicer-Mitchell slides after profit-warning.

text.p: Shares in penny-stock Spicer-Mitchell Holdings Ltd fell on Monday after it announced that its results for the half-year to June 30 had been hit by tough markets.

It said earlier that its parent City Investment Holdings Ltd (Cityhold) would also be negatively affected by continuing adverse business conditions prevailing in the aluminium extrusion and geyser manufacturing industries.
"After the profit warning the shares came down. There is still some downside potential in the share," one dealer said.
By 0800 GMT Spicer-Mitchell had dropped 16.67 percent to a new year low of 25 cents in thin volume of 65,100 shares. Cityhold was last unchanged at 30 cents.
The company said that several projects were currently underway to restructure both firms' interests in the aluminium extrusion and geyser manufacturing industries.
